# PixelDab

> PixelDab (also known as PixelDab Designs) is a graphic design studio, established in 2016, creating brand identities, logos, apparel, posters, and murals for businesses, nonprofits, and events.

## Services

- Brand identity and logo design
- T-shirt and apparel design
- Poster and event design
- Murals and fine art
- Packaging, typography, and art direction

## Selected work

- 106 Memorial Foundation: identity, logo, and shirt design
- Doc's Food Truck Park: logo and custom mascot design
- 106 Poker Run: T-shirt and poster design
- Oksterdam: branding, logo, T-shirt, and sticker design
- Dream Maker LLC: identity, logo, and sign design
- GCG Summer Bash 2025: T-shirt design
